soundtouch-processor.js and its map are copied without modification.
orbit-pitch-processor.js is an ORBIT modification: applies processorOptions.stretchParameters synchronously before the first block and uses the separate orbit-pitch-processor name. The complete modified readable JavaScript source is included in this file. Reproduction patch: scripts/vendor-audio.mjs.
